note: The lecture format's defaults, read by tools/lecture.py and lib/lecture alike. A lecture.json overrides any of them under the same key.

rules.note_close: true: after the last word the chalk goes down on a hidden table in front of the presenter (staging.table), the hands are dusted, a look and a smile. Off by default: place the table for your presenter first (`tools/lecture.py check` says if a hand is short of it or the body goes into it)

staging.note_table: the table the chalk goes down on at the close: hidden, in front of the presenter on the chalk hand's side (board pixel column and metres out, size and height in metres, all in the hall's measure)
